asha: hi team, first week q: I'm wiring up `payments-proxy` and need Vault/KMS access for dev + staging. What's the recommended pattern for secrets (no prod yet) and how to request short-lived creds? cc @kim

kim (DevEx): welcome, asha! :wave: recommended pattern for non-prod: 1) use Vault DB roles for DB creds (ephemeral leases), 2) store API keys/DSNs in KV but mark them with a rotation policy, 3) avoid long-lived KMS keys in dev — prefer service account/workload identity. Steps: join `vault-users` org team, fill the secrets-request form (pick env=dev/staging, purpose=onboarding). Link: https://go.redwood.internal/forms/secrets-request

Quick test commands (after access):
```bash
vault login -method=oidc
vault kv get secret/data/services/payments-proxy/dev
# for DB ephemeral creds
vault read database/creds/payments-proxy-role
```

vault-bot: access request received for asha. Ticket #V-2026 created.

infra-ops: for staging if you need an encryption key (e.g., to test envelope encryption), request a dev-key alias. We'll provision a key with automatic rotation every 30 days by default for non-prod. Include `rotation_days` if you want a different cadence. Template: `env=staging, service=payments-proxy, key_purpose=encryption, rotation_days=30, owner=asha@redwood.com`.

ryan (DB): for DB access, tell us which DB cluster (dev-payments or staging-payments). We prefer creating a role that issues short leases (1h-6h). If your service needs longer-lived connections for background jobs, we can increase TTL but prefer renewing with Vault.

asha: thanks — one more: how does rotation work for KV secrets? do I need to do anything programmatically?

kim (DevEx): good q — KV values don't auto-rotate. Options: 1) rotate manually and update deployment config; 2) use a rotation job that pulls new value from secret manager and updates consumers (we have a reference GitHub Action: https://go.redwood.internal/actions/kv-rotate). For most onboarding use, set a 30/60 day cadence and put a reminder in your runbook. For production, talk to security about automating rotations + webhook callbacks.

asha: great. filing the form now. if I need a short-lived token for immediate smoke tests, who do I ping?

infra-ops: ping @kim or reply to ticket #V-2026. We can issue a 24h token for testing.

asha: awesome, thanks everyone!
